svg.title: The Q table drawn on the cliff grid
svg.desc: A 4 by 12 cliff grid. Each cell is cut into four triangles that hold the learned score of each move after 10,000 recorded updates; arrows trace the 13-move route along the cliff edge.

g.font-family: Patrick Hand, Chalkboard SE, Comic Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Q-learning: the table, drawn on the cliff grid
